title: AxoNyxPackv1
description: A texturepack meant for pvp and the best experience for gaming
body:
This pack is for pvp and survival. I especially liked it for sword pvp but for crystal and stuff its also great. If u want to use this pack in videos u can but u gotta give credit to the creator. I would recommend using the mod totem tweaks and the recourcepack: low fire from CapTommy on modringth.

Also if you wanna check out the actual showcase or wanna know about new versions coming out than check out my youtube channel down below.

https://www.youtube.com/@AxoDraw
